name: La Quintrala
contribution: A Chilean landowner and member of the colonial elite whose life became the subject of numerous accusations of murder and abuse and, subsequently, a major legend in Chilean popular culture.

checks.lead: Catalina de los Ríos y Lisperguer (October 1604 – 15 January 1665), commonly known as La Quintrala, was a Chilean landowner and member of the colonial elite whose life became the subject of numerous accusations of murder and abuse and, subsequently, a major legend in Chilean popular culture. She belonged to the powerful de los Ríos and Lisperguer families and controlled extensive properties in central Chile. Contemporary and later accounts accused her of murdering members of her household and abusing enslaved people and other dependents, although the surviving evidence consists largely of accusations, judicial proceedings, and later narratives rather than a record of convictions for the numerous murders attributed to her.
